content:
**Spruce Knob Campground** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

The Settlers built Foundation on top of Spruce Knob, affording the group a commanding view of the nearby hills and valleys. [1] The area surrounding a collapsed mine shaft to the south, in the campground area, was fortified and occupied by them.

Located on the shores of Spruce Knob Lake, this campground once offered a place for hikers to rest and relax before returning to the trail. It is a Mirelurk breeding ground, though it can also be inhabited by Ticks and Wolves. A small camp due north, at the base of the monorail pillar, may contain a random Vault-Tec Bobblehead.

Spruce Knob Campground appears in *Fallout 76*.

Spruce Knob Campground is based on the real-world Spruce Knob Lake Campground.
